command_translation.export.guide:
# Translating this pack

Target language: %s

Translate the target language JSON under assets/command_translation/lang. Keep en_us.json as the English reference (when English itself is the target, select the intended game language and export again). Do not rename keys or change values listed in protected_keys in translation-manifest.json. These values are namespace, registry or parser bindings, not display text.

Alias values must contain no whitespace; use underscores for multiword aliases and preserve | between alternatives. Preserve placeholders, escapes, original IDs and syntax. Do not invent purposes for missing_descriptions: add descriptions only from the mod documentation or another reliable source. command_root_namespaces lists commands whose owner was not provided; their original root is the export namespace, not an inferred mod ID.

After translation, replace only the target language file and keep pack.mcmeta at the ZIP root. Enable the pack in Resource Packs and reload resources. The original English input remains available.

command_translation.help.command.advance: Gives or takes an advancement or its criterion from one or more players.
command_translation.help.command.attribu: Used to change or read attributes.
command_translation.help.command.ban: Adds players to the server's ban list.
command_translation.help.command.ban-ip: Adds IP addresses to the server's ban list.
command_translation.help.command.banlist: Lists banned players, IP addresses, or both.
command_translation.help.command.clear:
Clears items from player inventory, including items 
being dragged by the player. Can also detect and query the amount of specified items.
command_translation.help.command.clone: Clones blocks from one region to another.
command_translation.help.command.command: Exports missing command translations for resource-pack and mod authors.
command_translation.help.command.damage: Applies a set amount of damage to the specified entities.
command_translation.help.command.data: Allows the user to get, merge, modify, and remove NBT data of a block entity, entity, or Command NBT storage.
command_translation.help.command.datapac:
Controls the loading/unloading of data packs.
Note that feature flags can be enabled through data pack only when creating the world. Data packs requiring a feature flag that is not enabled cannot be loaded by this command.
If a built-in datapack in the path of datapacks in the vanilla datapack is enabled during world creating, it cannot be disabled by this command.
command_translation.help.command.debug: Starts or stops a time profiler session. Gets more detailed information of function execution.
command_translation.help.command.default: Sets the default game mode (Creative, Survival, etc.) for new players entering a multiplayer server. If in multiplayer and force-gamemode in the server.properties file is true, or if in LAN world, all online players are set to this game mode.
command_translation.help.command.deop: Revokes operator status from a player.
command_translation.help.command.dialog: Manages dialog screens displayed to players. Allows server operators to show custom or predefined dialogs in data pack to specified players, and clear any displayed dialogs on their screen.
command_translation.help.command.difficu: Sets or queries the difficulty level (peaceful, easy, etc.).
command_translation.help.command.effect: Adds or removes status effects of players and other entities.
command_translation.help.command.enchant: Adds an enchantment to a player's selected item, subject to the same restrictions as an anvil. Also works on any mob or entity holding a weapon;tool;armor in its main hand only.
command_translation.help.command.execute: Executes another command but allows changing the executor, changing the position and angle it is executed at, adding preconditions, and storing its result.
command_translation.help.command.experie: Adds, removes or queries player experience.
command_translation.help.command.fetchpr: Fetches the contents of a player profile from Minecraft servers.
command_translation.help.command.fill: Fills all or parts of a region with a specific block.
command_translation.help.command.fillbio: Fills a specified area with a specific biome.
command_translation.help.command.forcelo: Force chunks to load constantly or not, or lists/queries forceloaded chunks.
command_translation.help.command.functio: Runs commands found in the corresponding function file(s) with command execution context (executor, execution position, angles, etc) of the /function command itself.
command_translation.help.command.gamerul: Sets or queries a game rule value.
command_translation.help.command.give: Gives a specified amount of a certain item to one or more players.
command_translation.help.command.item: Manipulate or copy items in the inventories of blocks (chests, furnaces, etc.) or entities (players or mobs).
command_translation.help.command.jfr: Starts and stops profiling with Java Flight Recorder (JEP) as well as a few custom events.
command_translation.help.command.kick:
Kicks a player off the server, and displays an optional reason to it.
The player in a single player world or the host of a world cannot be kicked.
command_translation.help.command.locate: Displays the coordinates for the closest generated structure or biomes of a given type in the chat for the player who executed the command. In Java Edition, it can also display for the closest points of interest.​[upcoming: BE]
command_translation.help.command.loot: Drops the given loot table into the specified inventory or into the world.
command_translation.help.command.me: Broadcasts a narrative message in third person.
command_translation.help.command.msg: Sends a private message to one or more players.
command_translation.help.command.op:
Grants operator status to the player(s).
In Java Edition, adds the players into the ops.json file with the default op permission level specified by op-permission-level in the server.properties.
In Bedrock Edition, changes the player's permission in the "Player Permission" screen to the "Operator" option . In dedicated servers, it is also recorded in permissions.json. The permissions.json file can be reloaded with /permission command.
command_translation.help.command.pardon: Removes players from the server's ban list.
command_translation.help.command.pardon-: Removes IP addresses from the server's ban list.
command_translation.help.command.perf:
Captures information and metrics about the game such as tick durations, used heap sizes, and other more detailed stats.
Note that this command can only be executed on a dedicated server; use F3 + L run the performance profiler on a locally hosted world.
command_translation.help.command.place: Places a configured feature, structure, structure template, or template pool if possible.
command_translation.help.command.playsou: Plays a specified sound to a player, in a location, and in a specific volume and pitch.
command_translation.help.command.publish: Opens singleplayer world to the local network.
command_translation.help.command.random: Generates a random integer, or controls random sequences in the world.
command_translation.help.command.recipe: Gives or takes (unlocks or locks) recipes for players.
command_translation.help.command.reload:
Reloads data packs in Java Edition, or reloads functions and scripts in behavior packs in Bedrock Edition.
If a data pack or behavior pack has invalid data (such as an invalid recipe format), changes are not applied and the game continues using the previous data.[needs testing in Bedrock Edition]
command_translation.help.command.return:
A command that can be embedded inside a function to control its execution.
It ends function execution and sets the successfulness and the return value of the function, which is returned to the /function command as its output values, or the /execute if function ... command to test.
It can also end a forking /execute command that has multiple branches at the first branch.
command_translation.help.command.ride: Allows entities to mount or dismount other entities.
command_translation.help.command.rotate: Changes the rotation of an entity.
command_translation.help.command.save-al: Saves the server's world data to disk.
command_translation.help.command.save-of: Disables automatic saving of the server's world data.
command_translation.help.command.save-on: Enables automatic saving of the server's world data.
command_translation.help.command.say: Broadcasts message in the chat to all players on the server.
command_translation.help.command.scorebo: Manages and displays scores for various scoreboard objectives.
command_translation.help.command.seed: Displays the world seed, which can be copied on click.
command_translation.help.command.setbloc: Changes a block to another block.
command_translation.help.command.setidle: Sets the time before idle players are kicked from the server. Any players idle for <minutes> are kicked.
command_translation.help.command.spawnpo:
This command sets the spawn point for a player.
This command works in any dimension and can set the player's spawn point into any dimension.
command_translation.help.command.spectat:
Causes a player in Spectator mode to spectate another entity or stop spectating.
If the spectator is away from the target, the command will result in a camera follow mode, instead of the default first-person view.
command_translation.help.command.spreadp: Teleports entities to random surface locations within an area. Despite its name, this command can be used to teleport any entities, not just players.
command_translation.help.command.stop: Stops a server. Saves all changes to disk, then shuts down the server. Additionally, all players are kicked out of the server.
command_translation.help.command.stopwat:
Allows manipulation of stopwatches to keep track of real time — the time measured is not affected by the game's tick rate (i.e. pausing, /tick, or even server lag). This makes it useful to detect and compensate for lag e.g. when programming functions in a data pack.
Their elapsed time can be checked against a value range using /execute (if|unless) stopwatch.
command_translation.help.command.swing: Controls the swinging animation of entities' hands.
command_translation.help.command.tag:
Controls scoreboard tags on individual entities. In Java Edition, the number of tags owned by an entity cannot exceed 1024.
Java Edition note: This is distinct from entity type tags, which are applied to entity types and can't be changed by commands.
command_translation.help.command.teammsg: Sends a message to all players in the team of the entity who runs the command.
command_translation.help.command.telepor:
Teleports entities (players, mobs, etc.).
Although most commands can affect only chunks that have already been generated, /teleport can send entities into chunks that have yet to be generated. Right before teleporting, the game generates the destination chunk.
command_translation.help.command.tell: Sends a private message to one or more players.
command_translation.help.command.tellraw: Sends a JSON message to players.
command_translation.help.command.tick: The /tick command provides utilities for modifying the target tick rate of the game, temporarily fast forwarding the game, and pausing the game server side among other things. The /tick command cannot be executed from a command block.
command_translation.help.command.time: Changes or queries the world's game time or the time of a world clock.
command_translation.help.command.title: Controls text displayed on the screen.
command_translation.help.command.tm: Sends a message to all players in the team of the entity who runs the command.
command_translation.help.command.tp:
Teleports entities (players, mobs, etc.).
Although most commands can affect only chunks that have already been generated, /teleport can send entities into chunks that have yet to be generated. Right before teleporting, the game generates the destination chunk.
command_translation.help.command.transfe: Triggers a transfer of a player to another server.
command_translation.help.command.trigger: Changes the executor player's score in a scoreboard objective with a "trigger" criterion, and un-enables the objective for this player. Allows non-operator players to modify their own scoreboard objectives under tightly controlled conditions. Often used to let players activate systems controlled by data packs or command blocks.
command_translation.help.command.version: Presents the server's game version information to the client on the chat.
command_translation.help.command.w: Sends a private message to one or more players.
command_translation.help.command.waypoin: Manages waypoints displayed on the locator bar. Allows querying existing waypoints of entities and modifying their appearance properties like color and fade effect.
command_translation.help.command.weather: Sets the weather. In Bedrock Edition, it can also be used to get the current weather.
command_translation.help.command.whiteli:
Used to manage server whitelists.
In Java Edition, server operators can always connect when the whitelist is active, even if their profiles do not appear in the whitelist. In Bedrock Edition, players must be whitelisted regardless of operator status. The profiles of the whitelisted players are stored in the whitelist.json or allowlist.json‌[Bedrock Edition  only] configuration file.
